newsitem.title: USA: VitalCom to recruit new CEO/President.
newsitem.headline: VitalCom to recruit new CEO/President.

text.p: VitalCom Inc's Chairman said on Wednesday that the company intends to expand its management with a new president and chief executive officer.

Donald Judson, chairman, president and chief executive officer, said, "I am actively recruiting a new president and chief executive officer to run VitalCom's operations ... a recent health problem has limited my available time and precludes me from filling both the day-to-day operations and the strategic roles."
"I intend to remain an active chairman, driving the strategic direction of the company," Judson added.

VitalCom provides communication networks that acquire, interpret and distribute data generated by patient monitors located throughout a healthcare facility and sells central monitoring systems, clinical analysis and display software.
